utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, would you please call case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, The Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. May we have the appearances for today, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. Barney Thomas and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Thomas. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. Daniela Tasic, Chad Mair, Tina Drolec, Novak Lukic, and I'm Mr. Guy-Smith appearing on behalf of General Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Guy-Smith. Yes, Mr. Thomas.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. If we could please go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. The matter stands adjourn until tomorrow, quarter past 2.00 in the afternoon. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 17th day of March, 2009, at 2.15 p.m. 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.01 p.m.,
